title: Refining Generative Process with Discriminator Guidance in Score-based Diffusion Models
why_added: trains a real-against-generated classifier on noisy inputs and adds its gradient; cited by Correcting Diffusion, p. 9
property: realism (real versus generated), per class on class-conditional runs
reads: Noisy x_t and t through a frozen ADM classifier; its last-pooling latent (8x8x512) and t enter a small U-Net encoder that outputs real/fake; class-conditional on conditional CIFAR-10 and ImageNet
trained_on: Real training images against the frozen model's final samples re-noised at random t, with binary cross-entropy; ImageNet 256 uses 1,281,167 real and 400,000 (ADM) or 1,281,167 (DiT) generated; CIFAR-10 uses 50k real and 25k or 50k generated
gradient_enters: Adds w_DG times grad log(d/(1-d)) to the frozen score on t in [t_mid, T]; w_DG is 1, 2 or adaptive and t_mid is 0.01 or 0.1; no norm cap
unseen: no: every discriminator guides the same classes or dataset it trained on; only the frozen feature extractor is reused across datasets
headline: ImageNet 256 FID (lower is better): 1.83 for DiT-XL/2-G++ against 2.27 for DiT-XL/2-G and 1.68 for validation data, with G++ also setting its own classifier-guidance schedule; the discriminator alone at weight 1 moves ADM-G from 4.59 to 4.18
copy_or_avoid: Consider its log-odds gradient and frozen-feature head; do not cite it for transfer across concepts, and do not assume its exactness theorem holds for a PoE score (inferred)
model: EDM / LSGM / Soft Truncation / ADM / DiT-XL/2 (no text-to-image model)
